payload.title: Admit existing product and operator capabilities without replacement
payload.goal: Bind useful existing capabilities to a current source and exclusive execution contract, consuming release-worker returns when available.
payload.owner_role: Designated Windows release parent assigns one admitted implementation owner; separate exact-source reviewer; existing scheduled operator retains integration/effect ownership
implementation_steps: Compare fresh source with the inspected ref and any returned release manifest; qualify scanner, CLI, lead intake, operator, watchdog and deployment map individually.
Read existing coordination claim and latest run metadata read-only at admission; record active owner and allowed action scopes without changing schedules.
Ask the designated Jira writer to match BOTS and PCH scope and return current native fields, source/spec hash and path reservation; retain accepted work.
Record same-business integration interface: runtime proposals enter the existing operator; a later takeover requires destination reconciliation and fencing before activation.
tests: Manifest validates every capability against source path/ref and test or receipt limits; absent payment and private CRM evidence remain unknown.
Reject admission for a conflicting path owner, wrong source hash, unqualified account or stale release receipt.

review.identity_requirement: Reviewer-authored record with actual reviewer identity, model/effort and host; distinct-model qualification is required for runtime/release acceptance and is not supplied by this plan.
review.exact_source: Bind immutable implementation commit, task/spec hash, artifact hashes, executed test receipts and any destination receipt. New source invalidates prior approval.
review.bounded_repairs: At most two targeted repair/review cycles; unresolved findings become a linked blocked task, preserving attempts.

acceptance: Exact source/ref and current owner are recorded; every reused capability has bounded proof and a verification action.
Product tasks can proceed under their existing release admission; wider autonomy dependencies do not halt the running operator.
payload.rollback: Revoke only the new admission/proposal version; leave existing scheduler, source and deployment ownership intact.
payload.next_eligible_action: Read the current release return and prepare scope-matching outbox; do not dispatch a scheduler.

estimate.assumptions: New planning range for admitted implementation and bounded review; reuses evidenced assets; excludes observation waiting, non-delegable account work and shared-platform implementation. Not a replacement for historical Jira estimates or measured actuals.
estimate.dependency_risk: Current active owner and newer release changes may require a narrow rebase.
